changelog: Removed the unreachable in-app bug report path. The Report Bug button has always linked straight to GitHub issues, the modal behind this feature was never rendered anywhere, and nothing called its API — so it was an authenticated endpoint that emailed a hardcoded address and could not be triggered from the UI. Reporting bugs is unchanged: the button still opens GitHub.
Includes 3.2.113: the Server Hostname placeholder uses a reserved documentation domain.

Includes 3.2.105-3.2.112: user roles scoped to customers (issue #21), immediate effect for user removal and role changes, migrations shipped through the update channel, Bare Metal Restore and client installers scoped per endpoint, VHD export fixed, unrestorable images kept out of the restore picker, and the installer card reporting the address it is actually built with.
